Hindutva Influencer Claims Self-Defense After Bragging About Assault

Hindutva influencer Swatantra Bhardwaj, who previously bragged about cracking a man's skull, has now claimed the incident was an act of self-defense. Bhardwaj denied making the initial remarks, alleging he was attacked and would have been lynched if he hadn't acted in self-defense. He also claimed a viral video of the incident was fake.
